research_mode: official Home Office accredited statistics; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Guilty pleas
verified_claims: Of the 67 convicted persons, 39, or 58%, pleaded guilty.
limitations: Plea distributions do not establish local public-safety conditions.

sources.name: Not-guilty pleas
verified_claims: Of the 67 convicted persons, 28, or 42%, entered a not-guilty plea.
limitations: A plea category is a court-process measure and not parcel evidence.

sources.name: Terrorism-connected custody total
verified_claims: There were 273 persons in custody for terrorism and terrorism-connected offences in Great Britain on 31 March 2026.
limitations: Custody totals do not identify where offences occurred or local risk.

sources.name: Custody annual change
verified_claims: The custody total was seven higher than the 266 recorded on 31 March 2025.
limitations: A national custody change cannot be assigned to neighbourhoods or parcels.

sources.name: MPS section 43 stops
verified_claims: The Metropolitan Police Service stopped and searched 98 persons under section 43 of the Terrorism Act 2000.
limitations: The count covers a police-force area and excludes vehicle-only searches.

sources.name: MPS section 43 annual change
verified_claims: The 98 MPS section 43 stops were 36% higher than the 72 in the previous year.
limitations: The annual change is not a parcel-level exposure rate.

sources.name: Other-force section 43 stops
verified_claims: Other police forces in England and Wales reported a further 108 section 43 stops.
limitations: These newly collected figures are official statistics in development and have data-quality limitations.

sources.name: MPS arrests after section 43 stops
verified_claims: Sixteen arrests resulted from MPS section 43 stop and searches in the year ending 31 March 2026.
limitations: An arrest following a stop does not establish guilt or local parcel risk.

sources.name: Other-force arrests after section 43 stops
verified_claims: Other police forces in England and Wales reported 22 arrests resulting from section 43 stops.
limitations: The figures are under development and are not suitable for precise local scoring.

sources.name: Palestine Action arrest outcomes
verified_claims: Of 2,819 linked arrests, 484 were charged, 36 were released without charge, 12 had alternative action and 2,287 were bailed to return or released under investigation.
limitations: Many cases remained unresolved, so outcome proportions can change.

sources.name: Palestine Action charge rate
verified_claims: At the data cutoff, 484 of the 2,819 linked arrests, or 21%, had resulted in a charge.
limitations: The rate is provisional because many cases were still progressing.

sources.name: Palestine Action charge legislation
verified_claims: The linked charges included 8 under section 12 and 473 under section 13 of the Terrorism Act 2000.
limitations: Legislative charge counts do not establish conviction or property-level risk.

sources.name: Palestine Action cases awaiting prosecution
verified_claims: Of the 484 linked charges, 456 were awaiting prosecution.
limitations: Awaiting-prosecution cases are incomplete and may have different final outcomes.

sources.name: Palestine Action other outcomes
verified_claims: Twenty-five of the 484 linked charges had other outcomes.
limitations: The broad outcome category combines different resolutions and is not comparable to conviction.

sources.name: Palestine Action not proceeded
verified_claims: Three of the 484 linked charges were not proceeded against.
limitations: Small case counts must not be used for parcel inference.

sources.name: Palestine Action arrest sex distribution
verified_claims: Among 2,814 linked arrests where sex was known, 1,368 were male, 1,445 female and one non-binary.
limitations: Demographic aggregates must not be used to profile individuals or locations.

sources.name: Palestine Action age 30 and above
verified_claims: Among linked arrests with known age, 2,561, or 91%, were aged 30 or above.
limitations: Age composition is not a measure of neighbourhood risk.

sources.name: Average age comparison
verified_claims: The average age was 59 for linked arrests and 31 for all other arrests.
limitations: Average ages conceal variation and must not support individual or parcel inference.

sources.name: Age ranges
verified_claims: The reported age range was 17 to 89 for linked arrests and 13 to 70 for all other arrests.
limitations: Minimum and maximum ages are descriptive and not predictive.

sources.name: Recorded White ethnic appearance
verified_claims: Where ethnic appearance was known, 1,738 of 1,800 linked arrests, or 97%, were recorded as White by the arresting officer.
limitations: Officer-recorded appearance is not self-defined ethnicity and must not be used for profiling.
